title: Smoke Detector Request
description: Use this request to inquire about a smoke detector for owner occupied single-family and duplex residences. This does not apply to rental properties such as apartments or rent houses. The estimated response time for this service request is 2 business days.

observedQuestions.question: Are you requesting a smoke detector or batteries?
How did you find out about the program?
Does the requestor in the home own it?

conditionalPaths.instruction: This request is for battery operated smoke detectors to be installed in owner occupied homes. If this is a multifamily complex/apt. the property manager is responsible for providing this service.

observedQuestions.question: Is there anyone in the home with a disability, hearing impaired, or over the age of 65?
What is the best contact time?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Smoke detector; owner = Yes; all special-needs options selected; time supplied; contact = No; Details Continue reached Contact
detailsForm.contactStepObservation: First Name, Last Name, and Phone Number marked required

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a smoke detector or batteries in an owner-occupied home.
actions.why: For a smoke detector or batteries for an owner-occupied single-family or duplex residence. The 311 request form asks whether the requester wants a detector or batteries, whether they own the home, whether someone has a disability or hearing impairment or is over 65, and the best contact time.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Smoke Detector Request" requests does not apply to rental homes or apartments. If the residence is a multifamily complex or apartment, then contact the property manager for smoke-detector service.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Smoke Detector Request"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Smoke Detector Request"

actions.tagline: Contact the property manager about a smoke detector in an apartment.
actions.why: For smoke-detector service in a multifamily complex or apartment. The Smoke Detector Request form says the property manager is responsible when the requester does not own the home.
actions.how: Contact the property manager about smoke-detector service
actions.how_formatted: Contact the property manager about smoke-detector service
